sections.label: The problem
sections.lede: In tech, credibility gets diligenced. Before the term sheet, before the enterprise pilot, before the senior hire accepts, they search you.

items.text: Investors find nothing when they diligence you
Enterprise buyers hesitate on unknown vendors
Senior candidates cannot verify your momentum
AI tools skip you in your own category

sections.titleHtml: No retainers. No vague promises. No surprises.
sections.lede: PR has a reputation problem: monthly retainers, invisible work, reports full of “activity.” We run it differently, you know exactly what you are getting before you spend a rupee.
items: The outlet mix is mapped and agreed before you commit
Every story is written for you, nothing goes out without your sign-off
You get every live link in a proof report, ready to share
Placements are permanent, indexed on Google, citable by AI platforms
No long lock-ins, engage per placement or per campaign

items.title: Press Releases
items.text: News coverage, written and indexed where people check.

items.title: Magazine Features
items.text: Covers and editorial spreads that turn visibility into status.

items.q: We are pre-revenue. Is PR premature?
items.a: Not if you are raising, hiring or selling. The story is the vision and the team, coverage makes both verifiable when it matters.

items.q: Can you time coverage to our funding announcement?
items.a: Yes. Announcement embargoes and coordinated distribution are standard for funding stories, we plan the date with you.
Our writers turn technical products into stories business media will run, and you review every draft for accuracy before it goes out.
